translated_title: Beatriz Mojica: From Criticizing AMLO to Coordinating Morena in Guerrero
original_title: Beatriz Mojica: de sus críticas a AMLO a la coordinación de Morena en Guerrero
author: José Shaddai Olvera Torres
outlet: El Chamuco y los Hijos del Averno
meta_description: The senator on leave was designated by Morena as state coordinator in Guerrero heading into 2027, after a career that includes the PRD and her 2018 support for Ricardo Anaya.
